G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan. This harvest searched it with infrastructure and hazard phrases in English and Japanese and read 1,374 datasets; the ones whose titles name a transport, energy, water, digital or facility element or a hazard are catalogued as records of their own, and the rest (statistics, laws, contracts, culture, health and similar) ... Coverage: Japan. 1,374 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 403 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
